tanvi (sec): FYI - after the RBAC prune last night a handful of customers started seeing SSO failures and deprovision calls returning 403. Unsure if this is an RBAC attribute change or a KMS rekey mismatch, filing here for triage.
ashley (eng): ugh, saw alerts. Which customers and which error in the logs?
sam (sre): pulling logs now, tagging @david for IDP context.
sam (sre): logs show SCIM response 403 with upstream error from identity-service: 
```
2026-02-07T03:12:18Z identity-service ERROR scim: deprovision user extid=acme|U-12345 -> 403
2026-02-07T03:12:18Z identity-service WARN kms: unwrap failed: DecryptionError: encryption_context_mismatch (expected {"tenant":"acme","role_hash":"r_abc123"}, got {"tenant":"acme","role_hash":"r_oldadmin"})
```
ashley (eng): that encryption_context_mismatch pretty clearly smells like the RBAC rename - role_hash changed during migration.
david (idp): yep — our KMS envelope includes role_hash at wrap time. When the role name/attributes change we need to rewrap extids or the unwrap will fail.
danvi_typo: (typo)
ashley (eng): @david can you confirm whether the rollforward changed role slugs or we accidentally backfilled a different canonicalization?
david (idp): quick check: deployment notes show we normalized role names to lowercase + trim on 2026-02-06, that produces a new role_hash for ~8 roles. The extid values stored in DB are still wrapped with the old context. KMS won’t unwrap without exact match.
tanvi (sec): impact? how many active deprovisions are failing? SLO/op impact?
sam (sre): quick query on prod queue: 7 failed deprovisions in last 30m, 3 distinct tenants (acme, northwind, bluelab). No high-severity downtime but customers see deprovision not completing.
ashley (eng): can we do a targeted rewrap/backfill for affected tenants? Any risk to rewrapping en masse?
david (idp): rewrap approach: fetch DB rows where wrap_meta.role_hash != current_role_hash and call KMS rewrap API with `source_context` set to old and `target_context` to new. If unwrap fails we log and skip. We'll do dry-run first.
david (idp): sample command we use in staging:
```
python tools/identity_rewrap.py \
  --tenant acme \
  --batch-size 100 \
  --dry-run
```
sam (sre): ran dry-run for acme (100 rows) -> 12 candidates, all show context mismatch. No unwrap performed in dry-run.
ashley (eng): next steps? windows for canary?
david (idp): propose canary: rewrap acme during low traffic window, verify SCIM deprov flow, then roll to northwind/bluelab. We'll keep audit logs and record counts.
tanvi (sec): please also add a reversible safety guard (if error rate spikes, pause). And file an update to the audit trail so compliance has change context.
sam (sre): ok, I'll create a short runbook patch and a quick puppet job that pauses on >5% errors.
ashley (eng): what's the audit entry we should look for? sample lines: 
```
2026-02-07T03:12:19Z audit.log INFO actor=rbac-migration service=rbac action=rename_role before_slug="Admin" after_slug="admin" tx_id=tx-9f2
2026-02-07T03:12:20Z audit.log INFO actor=identity service=kms action=rewrap candidate=acme|U-12345 tx_id=tx-9f3
```
tanvi (sec): add that tx id to the ticket and link to compliance workspace. Also check key rotation events in KMS (we didn't rotate keys but double-check).
david (idp): checked KMS: no key rotation during the window; this is purely context mismatch.
sam (sre): starting a controlled rewrap for acme now (non-destructive dry-run passed). Command: `python tools/identity_rewrap.py --tenant acme --batch-size 50`
okta-bot: notice: 2026-02-07T03:15:02Z okta API event user=U-12345 group_removal=admins
sam (sre): run finished: 12 objects rewrapped successfully, 0 failed. Triggered a couple SCIM retries and deprov queue drained for acme.
ashley (eng): nice. Can we add a post-mortem note: root cause = RBAC canonicalization change + KMS envelope that included mutable role_hash. Remediation = rewrap flow + update runbook to rewrap during role slug changes.
tanvi (sec): agree. Also recommend we change envelope to include immutable identifiers (role_id) instead of role name/hash in future; file a tech debt ticket.
david (idp): filed ticket ID: IDP-734 to change envelope context to immutable role_id.
sre-bot: deploy 2026-02-07T04:00:00Z identity-rewrap-runner v2 -> success :white_check_mark:
tanvi (sec): thanks team. I'll loop in compliance for audit signoff and add a blameless postmortem note. :thumbsup:
